configuration.experiment: RIBO-ATLAS-FM Wave E: masked-LM continued pretraining of official RNA-FM (rna-fm 0.2.2, RNA-FM_pretrained.pth) on Rfam 15.1 seed sequences, family/clan-held-out split
configuration.status: Prepared locally by Claude 15 Oct 2026; not uploaded, not submitted
configuration.approval: PI 15 Oct 2026: Wave E funded; RNA-FM code and weights may be downloaded to JUPITER

phase1_concurrent.P1_N8_sdpa: nodes 56-63, supplementary: same run with SDPA attention

plan.phase1_protocol: 10 untimed + 50 timed steps at 8,192 sequences/step, mode scaling, stop after step 60
plan.phase2: P2_N64 on all 64 nodes, mode train: eval step 0, steps 1-60 (timing), continue to step 72 (~1 more epoch), eval at epoch boundaries and step 72, save final model
plan.gate: phase 2 runs only if at least one primary phase-1 step exits 0

primary_endpoint.comparison: first evaluation step whose epochs_seen = step*global_batch/n_train >= 1.0 (step 12 = 1.061 epochs at 8,192 sequences/step and 92,684 training sequences) versus step 0
primary_endpoint.statistic: token-weighted masked-LM cross-entropy change (nats) and perplexity ratio, paired masks
primary_endpoint.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10,000 resamples of held-out families (primary family per sequence); group (clan/shared-sequence component) bootstrap as sensitivity
primary_endpoint.pre_specified: fixed before submission on 15 Oct 2026 (coordinator review); reported whatever its sign

secondary_endpoints.multi_epoch: heldout_family change at step 72 (about 6.4 epochs of a small, redundant corpus) versus step 0, explicitly labelled multi-epoch; the remaining epoch-boundary evaluations form the learning curve
secondary_endpoints.in_family: val_in_family change at the same steps (in-distribution contrast)

configuration.leakage_note: RNA-FM was pretrained on RNAcentral, which very likely already contains these Rfam seed sequences; the family/clan split controls leakage within Wave E continued pretraining only
configuration.analysis: analyze_waveE.py: efficiency vs P1_N8, tokens/s, HBM/RSS, per-step loss consistency; PRIMARY held-out-family CE change at the first evaluation >= 1.0 epoch (step 12) vs step 0 with family bootstrap (10,000) and group sensitivity; SECONDARY step-72 multi-epoch change, in-family contrast and epoch curve
